about.title: About Verbologic
about.p1: Verbologic is a decoupled, O(N)-scaling language-learning platform: static entity data, edge-delivered audio, instant client-side search, and an agentic dual-LLM build workflow.
about.p2: 532 Romanian & English entities recovered from the legacy roadmaps are already live in the searchable tracks.
